timeout: Increase timeout value / verify network latency / add retry mechanism.
retry: Enable retry logic or increase wait interval between commands.
authentication: Validate credentials, certificates or tokens used in session.
configuration: Check DUT configuration parameters / port mapping / VLAN setup.
protocol: Inspect protocol handshake, packet formatting & header encoding.
interface: Verify physical link status / port negotiation / driver compatibility.
memory: Check memory leaks / increase buffer size / optimize payload handling.
state mismatch: Reset DUT state / resynchronize PTP or SIP session.
command failure: Verify CLI commands, syntax and privileges.
packet drop: Check switch load, buffering and congestion handling.
unknown: No automated fix available — manual debugging required.
